_comment: Core settings seeded on every update_database run. Plugin-owned settings live in the plugin's plugin.json. See specs/declarative_plugin_settings.md for the scope principle. Values are always strings (use '0'/'1' for booleans, '42' for numbers).

settings.name: api_min_client_versions
settings.helptext: JSON map of client_app header value to minimum allowed client_version (semver). Clients below their minimum receive HTTP 426 UpgradeRequired on every API request. Empty map disables enforcement.

settings.name: api_session_key_lifetime_days
settings.helptext: Days until an API session key minted by /api/v1/auth/login expires (apk_expires_time). Existing keys keep the expiry they were minted with.

settings.name: app_bridge_key_check_seconds
settings.helptext: How often (seconds) an app-context web session re-verifies that its originating API session key is still live. 0 checks on every request. Lower values make key revocation propagate to app webviews faster at the cost of a key lookup per interval.

settings.name: app_navigation
settings.helptext: JSON map of client_app to the ordered menu slugs pinned to that app's tab bar (GET /api/v1/app/navigation). The default key applies to apps without their own entry; all other entries land in the app's More list.

settings.name: dns_default_provider
settings.helptext: The DNS host the publish box leads with. A provider NAME, never a secret — the key of a driver in includes/dns/drivers/ (linode, cloudflare, route53, …). Any other driver stays available behind the box's "use another provider" link.

settings.name: passkeys_enabled
settings.helptext: Emergency kill switch for passkey sign-in, enrollment, and PRF-based secret derivation. On by default — vault setup and protected mailboxes depend on it. Turn off only to disable all passkey operations deployment-wide.

settings.name: signal_bus_debug
settings.helptext: When on, the signal bus logs every dispatch (signal name + JSON payload) to the error log and flags any non-JSON-serializable payload value. Debug only; leave off in production.

settings.name: vault_unlock_idle_minutes
settings.helptext: Sealed Vault unlock window idle timeout, in minutes. One unlock opens every server-custody consumer (mail, chat); the window is extended on activity and wiped on close.

settings.name: debug
settings.label: Debug mode
settings.helptext: Site-wide, not payments-only: it drives component render tracing, FormWriter debug output, and the Stripe and Google Play helpers' test behaviour. Leave off in production.

settings.name: cloud_storage_draining
settings.helptext: Internal flag; set to 1 by Disable-and-Pull-Back so the offload tick pulls public cloud files back to local. Cleared automatically when no public cloud rows remain. Not edited directly.

settings.name: cloud_storage_private_bucket
settings.helptext: Bucket on the SAME provider/account as public cloud storage (shares its endpoint/region/keys), used for the verified-private store. Empty = no private store. Latched usable only after a Save whose anonymous-read-denied privacy gate passed.

settings.name: cloud_storage_private_draining
settings.helptext: Internal flag; set to 1 by the private store's Disable-and-Pull-Back so the offload tick pulls private cloud objects back to local. Cleared automatically when no private cloud rows remain. Not edited directly.

settings.name: cloud_storage_private_enabled
settings.helptext: Internal latch; set to 1 only after a private-bucket Save whose privacy gate passed. Not edited directly.

settings.name: standard_error
settings.default: Sorry, that operation caused an error.

settings.name: mailgun_webhook_signing_key
settings.label: Mailgun Webhook Signing Key
settings.helptext: HTTP Webhook Signing Key from your Mailgun dashboard (separate from the API key).

settings.name: sendgrid_inbound_secret
settings.label: Inbound Parse Shared Secret
settings.helptext: SendGrid Inbound Parse does not sign its POSTs. Set a secret here and append it to the Destination URL as ?secret=… so only SendGrid can deliver mail. Inbound is rejected while this is blank.

settings.name: sendgrid_inbound_spam_threshold
settings.label: Inbound spam score threshold
settings.helptext: When content spam filtering is on, an inbound spam_score at or above this value is judged spam. Default 5.0; lower is stricter.

settings.name: drive_active
settings.helptext: Master switch for the member Drive (/drive). Off by default; enable per instance.

settings.name: drive_max_folder_depth
settings.helptext: Maximum nesting depth for Drive folders.

settings.name: drive_upload_chunk_bytes
settings.helptext: Chunk size (bytes) the Drive resumable upload protocol requests. Default 8 MiB.

settings.name: api_upload_rate_limit_requests
settings.helptext: Max Drive chunk-upload requests per window per IP (own bucket, not the general API limit).

settings.name: api_upload_rate_limit_window
settings.helptext: Window (seconds) for the Drive chunk-upload rate limit.

settings.name: webDir
settings.label: Web Domain

messages.pattern: Enter the domain only — no http:// or https://, and no slashes.

settings.helptext: The site's domain, e.g. example.com. Everything that builds an absolute URL reads this.

settings.name: baseDir
settings.label: Base path
settings.helptext: Filesystem path to the deployment root. Overridden when Globalvars_site.php hardcodes it, in which case the field is shown read-only.

settings.name: node_dir
settings.label: Node Path
settings.helptext: Path to the node install used for asset builds, e.g. /var/www/html/mysite/node. Empty when the deployment has none.

settings.name: apache_error_log
settings.label: Apache Error Log Path
settings.helptext: Read by the admin log viewer. Must be a readable file — an unreadable path makes the settings page refuse every save.

settings.name: siteDir
settings.helptext: Auto-calculated from baseDir by Globalvars. Shown read-only on the settings page; never edited directly.

settings.name: upload_dir
settings.helptext: Auto-calculated from baseDir by Globalvars. Shown read-only on the settings page; never edited directly.

settings.name: static_files_dir
settings.helptext: Auto-calculated from baseDir by Globalvars. Shown read-only on the settings page; never edited directly.

settings.name: comment_notification_emails
settings.label: Emails to receive comment notifications (separate with comma)

settings.name: single_purchase_notification_emails
settings.label: Emails to receive one time purchase notifications (separate with comma)

settings.name: subscription_notification_emails
settings.label: Emails to receive subscription notifications (separate with comma)

settings.name: upgrade_server_active
settings.label: This deployment publishes upgrades
settings.helptext: Marks the deployment as an upgrade source. utils/upgrade.php also treats an active server_manager plugin as one.

settings.name: database_version
settings.helptext: Schema version reached by update_database. Written by the updater; read to decide which migrations still owe a run.

settings.name: db_migration_version
settings.helptext: Highest migration version applied. Written by the migration runner.

settings.name: system_version
settings.helptext: Release version of the deployed code. Written by the upgrade process.

settings.name: scheduled_tasks_last_cron_run
settings.helptext: Timestamp of the last scheduled-task cron tick. Written by the runner; read by the health display.

settings.name: file_signed_url_key
settings.helptext: HMAC key for signed file URLs, minted on first use by data/files_class.php with a race-safe INSERT. Never entered by hand.

settings.name: _store_event_autoactivate_v1
settings.helptext: One-shot marker: update_database auto-activated the store and event_manager plugins on this deployment. Presence is the whole meaning.

settings.name: mailgun_version
settings.helptext: DEAD. The Mailgun SDK version switch was removed (specs/implemented/remove_mailgun_version_setting.md); nothing reads or writes this. Declared so the surviving row is not an orphan. Safe to purge.

settings.name: allow_remote_archive_refresh
settings.helptext: DEAD. No reader or writer anywhere in the tree. Declared so the surviving row is not an orphan. Safe to purge.

settings.name: archive_refresh_allowed_ips
settings.helptext: DEAD. No reader or writer anywhere in the tree. Declared so the surviving row is not an orphan. Safe to purge.
